_doc: System service checks (tests/integration/systest.c): every CHECK must pass and nothing may panic.

test.fail.why: a system test CHECK failed (see warnings)

settings.saved.why: settings changes are written once per burst, one second after the last (detailed design §2.6)

cap.timeouts.why: the parked test call is answered at its deadline

cap.late.why: and its late completion is dropped

cap.replayed.why: a repeated request id is answered from the first receipt

hub.tools.echo.why: the remote proxy reached the hub capability

settings.saved_out_of_range.why: a saved value out of range falls back to the default
